anomalies.observed: Every VDD pin of both STM32 MCUs is placed in an automatically generated unconnected net; none of them appear on the +3.3V net.
anomalies.expected: The specification states that the 3.3 V rail feeds both MCUs, so all FCC1 and NAVC1 VDD pins should be connected to +3.3V.
anomalies.impact: The navigation and flight-control MCUs would not receive their digital supply and the board would not boot or operate.

anomalies.observed: The net named LED_A_FCC contains the LED_A_FCC signal nodes FCC1 PB1 and LED3 anode together with many 3.3 V supply nodes: I2C pull-up resistor tops, decoupling capacitors, connector VCC pins, boot-switch common pins, SWD VCC pins, and NAVC1 VBAT. It is not connected to the +3.3V net driven by REG2.
anomalies.expected: A signal net such as LED_A_FCC should only connect FCC1 PB1 to LED3. The 3.3 V supply loads should be on the +3.3V net connected to REG2 OUT.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The 3.3 V rail is split into an unconnected LED_A_FCC portion and a powered +3.3V portion; this would leave pull-ups, boot/SWD/connector supplies, and NAVC VBAT unpowered or incorrectly referenced, and would also tie the LED_A_FCC signal to a supply-like net.

anomalies.observed: The netlist contains no otter_CH330 USB-UART bridge components, and the USB3/USB4 D+ and D- pins are left unconnected.
anomalies.expected: The specification lists two otter_CH330 USB-UART converters in the Connections sheet for programming/debug UART-to-USB.
anomalies.impact: The UART-to-USB programming/debug interfaces would be absent or non-functional.
